mapper.select: SELECT MONTH(final_start) AS month, SUM(final_payment) AS totalFinalPayment, COUNT(*) AS count FROM wardrobe WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 AND final_start IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(final_start) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(final_start) ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) AS totalSpent, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN final_payment ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2) THEN final_payment ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paidTotal, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 END) AS pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2) THEN 1 END) AS paidCount FROM wardrobe WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT MONTH(create_time) AS month, COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) AS total FROM wardrobe WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MONTH(create_time) ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT brand, COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) AS total FROM wardrobe WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != '' GROUP BY brand ORDER BY total DESC
